guidance.title: Plan
guidance.text: Identify distance, speed and time, and the quantity requested.

guidance.title: Method
guidance.text: Use hours with km/h: divide minutes by 60. Include stops when total elapsed time is requested. Use speed = distance ÷ time, distance = speed × time, or time = distance ÷ speed.

guidance.title: Check
guidance.text: For a whole journey use total distance and total time; round only the final result and include units.
